services.name: jet ski tour
services.desc: At Fun Unlimited, we offer tours of the St. Petersburg waterways from the seat of a jet ski, a unique experience that is sure to thrill even the most seasoned Floridian. Fun Unlimited has the best of both worlds. We’re located in the sheltered, calm waters of Boca Ciega Bay at the Gulfport Municipal Marina, but we’re only 10 minutes from Gulfport and two miles from the ocean. Since we’re out of the crowds, we can offer you plenty of free parking and a fast, stress-free checkout process for your jet ski tour to all the popular sights.
